data.rationale: HDFC Bank post-merger is expected to maintain sector-leading metrics. Loan growth of 12-14% reflects normalization after merger adjustments and India's GDP growth of 6-7%. NIM projected at 3.7-4.0% assuming stable funding costs and competitive pressure. CASA ratio expected to improve gradually to 46% from current levels as retail franchise strengthens. Credit cost remains benign at 0.8-0.9% reflecting superior underwriting and seasoned portfolio. Cost-to-income improves to 39-42% as merger synergies materialize and operating leverage kicks in. ROA of 1.9-2.1% and ROE of 16.5-18% position HDFC Bank among top performers globally, supported by strong capital position (CAR ~18-19%), franchise strength, and digital adoption driving efficiency gains.
